name: National Career Service (NCS)
description: Online platform for job seekers and employers with job matching, career counselling, and training listings.
eligibility: Any job seeker (citizen) or employer in India.
benefits: Free job search, resume builder, career counselling, vacancy posting.
application_steps: Register as Job Seeker on ncs.gov.in.
processing_time: Instant registration; application response per employer.
office_locator_info: Model Career Centres and local employment exchanges.

faq.a: Yes, registration and job search are free for all.

ai_summary: NCS is a free national job portal connecting job seekers with employers and counselling.
ai_explanation: NCS offers a unified platform where job seekers register, build resumes, and apply to vacancies, while employers post jobs. It also provides career counselling and training information through Model Career Centres.
common_questions: How do I register on NCS?
How do I find jobs on NCS?
common_mistakes: Treating it as the only job source
suggested_followups: How do I post a job as an employer on NCS?
